class.name: CameraSettingsServer
class.brief_description: Settings server for the player camera: field of view, clip planes and motion values.

method.name: add_camera
method.description: Gives the settings to [param camera] now and on every later change, for example a camera created in code or one that is not in the group. Its authored values are remembered the first time. Calling it again does nothing more.

method.name: apply_to_cameras
method.description: Gives the settings to every camera in the group [method get_camera_group] that has not got them yet. Use it after adding a camera to the group while it is already in the scene tree; cameras that enter the tree in the group get the values without it.

method.name: get_camera_group
method.description: Returns the group of the cameras that get the settings when they enter the scene tree: [code]"camera_settings"[/code].

method.name: get_far
method.description: Returns the pending far clip plane distance. See [member CameraSettings.far].

method.name: get_field_of_view
method.description: Returns the pending field of view in degrees. See [member CameraSettings.field_of_view].

method.name: get_head_bob_intensity
method.description: Returns the pending head bob intensity. See [member CameraSettings.head_bob_intensity].

method.name: get_keep_aspect
method.description: Returns the pending FOV axis. See [member CameraSettings.keep_aspect].

method.name: get_managed_cameras
method.description: Returns the cameras that have the settings now: the cameras in the group that entered the tree and the cameras passed to [method add_camera], without those freed or passed to [method remove_camera].

method.name: get_motion_blur_intensity
method.description: Returns the pending motion blur intensity. See [member CameraSettings.motion_blur_intensity].

method.name: get_near
method.description: Returns the pending near clip plane distance. See [member CameraSettings.near].

method.name: get_shake_intensity
method.description: Returns the pending camera shake intensity. See [member CameraSettings.shake_intensity].

method.name: has_camera
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if [param camera] has the settings (see [method get_managed_cameras]).

method.name: is_enabled
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the managed cameras use the settings. See [member CameraSettings.enabled].

method.name: remove_camera
method.description: Gives [param camera] its authored values back and stops changing it. A camera still in the group gets the settings again when it enters the tree the next time; remove it from the group first if it should keep its own values.

method.name: set_enabled
method.description: Turns the settings on or off for the managed cameras. See [member CameraSettings.enabled].

method.name: set_far
method.description: Sets the far clip plane distance in meters. See [member CameraSettings.far].

method.name: set_field_of_view
method.description: Sets the field of view in degrees. See [member CameraSettings.field_of_view].

method.name: set_head_bob_intensity
method.description: Sets the head bob intensity ([code]0[/code] to [code]1[/code]). See [member CameraSettings.head_bob_intensity].

method.name: set_keep_aspect
method.description: Sets the axis the field of view is measured on. See [member CameraSettings.keep_aspect].

method.name: set_motion_blur_intensity
method.description: Sets the motion blur intensity ([code]0[/code] to [code]1[/code]). See [member CameraSettings.motion_blur_intensity].

method.name: set_near
method.description: Sets the near clip plane distance in meters. See [member CameraSettings.near].

method.name: set_shake_intensity
method.description: Sets the camera shake intensity ([code]0[/code] to [code]1[/code]). See [member CameraSettings.shake_intensity].
